evidence.finding: ProspectPilot from GrowthForge (Sales Intelligence): annual cost $22,000, 35 users, data access 'customer_pii', integrations: CRM, urgency 'normal'.
Requester Elena Garcia (IC3, Sales); manager Robert King (E007).
Sales software budget: annual $220,000, committed $202,000, available $18,000; request $22,000 is EXCEEDS the available budget (headroom $-4,000).
No approved catalog product shares the vendor, category or product name of ProspectPilot.
Internal registry: GrowthForge procurement status New, security Pending (no review date), legal terms Unknown.
Vendor-risk service: security review not_completed (last review none), risk high, processes personal data: yes, stores data outside region: yes.
Annual amount $22,000 falls in the $10,000.01-$25,000 band: minimum approvals Department Head, Finance, Procurement (policy s4).
Cost exceeds Sales's available budget: Finance budget-exception review required (policy s2).
Security review required because the request involves customer_pii (integration 'CRM' implies customer_pii) (policy s5).
Security review required: vendor security assessment not completed (policy s5).
Privacy review required: the tool will process customer_pii (policy s6).
Vendor stores data outside the operating region and the request involves sensitive data: Privacy and Legal review (policy s6, s7).
Legal review required: material cross-region data-processing issue; new vendor with annual spend $22,000 (>= $10,000); legal terms are 'Unknown', not approved/standard (policy s7).
Budget overrun: request $22,000 exceeds the $18,000 remaining in the Sales budget.
Vendor risk: GrowthForge has no completed security review and stores data outside the region.
Data sensitivity: ProspectPilot will access customer PII via CRM integration.

decision.next_step: Send the evidence package to Security, Privacy and Legal for review, then to Department Head, Procurement and Finance for approval. Do not purchase until every approval is recorded. Initiate a budget exception request and schedule security, privacy, and legal assessments for GrowthForge.
